head.h1: Full-Time Private Chef and Catering in Dubai — What It Costs and How to Book

opening_paragraph: A full time private chef catering Dubai placement puts one dedicated, vetted chef in your household kitchen every day, with occasion menus for guests from AED 700 per person. It is the arrangement families reach for when they want restaurant-standard food at home without the daily work of planning, shopping and cooking. Your chef runs the whole kitchen — from the weekly menu and grocery run to breakfast, lunch, dinner and clean-up — and steps up to host dinner parties when you entertain. Tell us about your household and schedule, we typically reply within 15 minutes during business hours, with an itemised proposal to follow.

new_paragraphs: How much does a private chef cost in Dubai?

For a dinner, AED 950 to AED 1300 per head at a table of two, AED 750 to AED 1000 at six, AED 700 to AED 950 at ten, and from AED 600 above twenty guests. The chef's day is shared between fewer people at a small table, which is why the per-head figure falls as the table grows.
How much does a full-time private chef cost in Dubai?

A full-time household placement is quoted per programme, based on daily meals, household size and days worked. For the occasion side the same chef covers, dinners start from AED 700 per person, set packages from AED 1200, and weekly meal prep from AED 1898. We quote every element in writing before you confirm.
Can you rent a private chef in Dubai?

Yes, in the sense people mean by it. You can have a private chef for a single evening from AED 700 per person, for a run of weeks through meal prep from AED 1898, or full-time in your kitchen on a placement quoted per programme. The same vetted chefs cover all three, so you can start with one evening and move up.
What is included with a full-time private chef?

Included are weekly menu planning, daily grocery shopping, cooking every meal, kitchen and pantry management, and clean-up — plus occasion and dinner-party menus when you host. The scope of full time private chef catering services in Dubai is agreed with you up front.
How do I hire a full-time private chef in Dubai?

Tell us your household size, schedule, cuisines and dietary needs. We match a vetted chef, send an itemised proposal — usually within one business day — and settle the chef into your kitchen once you confirm the scope and start date.
Can a full-time private chef cook halal and special diets?

Yes. Halal cooking is standard, and vegetarian, vegan and keto meals are prepared daily. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event.
Can the same chef cater dinner parties and events?

Yes. Beyond daily family meals, your chef handles full time private chef party catering in Dubai — dinner parties, corporate hosting and celebrations at home — with occasion menus from AED 700 per person and set packages from AED 1200.
Is a full-time chef better value than hiring per event?

For households that entertain often or want daily home-cooked meals, a full-time placement usually works out more affordable per meal than booking separately each time. For occasional needs, a part-time chef or weekly meal prep may suit better.
For full time private chef catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

Dietary requirements and family preferences are mapped up front and kept current as they change, with declared allergens recorded and handled carefully, though cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed. Because one chef learns your household, waste falls, favourites are remembered, and the weekly shop gets sharper over time. add_block.new_heading: How much does a full-time private chef cost in Dubai?
new_paragraphs: A full-time placement is quoted per programme instead of per head, based on the number of daily meals, household size, days worked and cuisine, so full time private chef catering prices in Dubai are set to your exact arrangement. To give you concrete figures for the occasion side: dinner-party and event cooking the same chef delivers starts from AED 700 per person and rises toward AED 950 for premium menus and full service; set full time private chef catering packages in Dubai begin around AED 1200; a multi-course tasting menu at home is AED 1400; and structured weekly meal prep runs from AED 1898 to AED 2698. We are open about what drives the full time private chef catering cost in Dubai, so you can weigh the best full time private chef catering against a more affordable full time private chef catering plan. See our prices and catering price guide , or request an itemised quote.

If the question underneath is what a private chef costs in Dubai generally, those per-head figures are published and do not move with the season: a dinner runs AED 950 to AED 1300 a head at a table of two, AED 800 to AED 1100 at four, AED 750 to AED 1000 at six, AED 700 to AED 950 at ten, and from AED 600 once you are above twenty. Small tables carry the chef's whole day between fewer people, which is the entire reason the figure falls as the table grows.

A placement is not priced that way because the variable is not headcount, it is how much of the week the chef works. Four things set the number: the meals cooked each day, the days worked, whether the chef lives in or travels to you, and how often you entertain. Two households of the same size can sit a long way apart on all four, which is why a placement comes back as a written programme quote instead of a published rate — and why we put every element of it in writing before you commit to anything.
